summary.title: Complete OT Cybersecurity Testbed
summary.description: Complete STRIDE model for the CYB691-IT691 Capstone Project repository, including OT infrastructure, Purdue zones, telemetry sources, normalization, triage, machine learning, hardening, policy, and software supply-chain assets.

diagrams.title: Complete OT Testbed STRIDE Analysis
diagrams.placeholder: Complete repository-level OT cybersecurity threat model

data.name: Purdue OT Testbed Network
data.description: Virtualized Purdue Model environment containing traffic generation, pfSense, Suricata, OpenPLC, and Conpot. Implementation of microsegmentation and hardening requires evidence validation.

data.name: Analysis and Evidence Zone
data.description: Telemetry ingestion, parsing, normalized data, triage, ML evaluation, and reports. Requires authenticated transfer, sandboxing, least privilege, integrity, provenance, and retention.

data.name: Enterprise / Developer Zone
data.description: Source repository, developers, dependency manifests, security policy, and administrative access.

data.name: Operator
data.description: Runs baseline Modbus polling and unauthorized-write scenarios. Identity, MFA, RBAC, approvals, and audit logging require validation.

threats.title: Operator identity impersonation
threats.description: An attacker could impersonate an operator if named accounts, MFA, or access controls are absent.
threats.mitigation: Use named accounts, MFA, RBAC, approval for unauthorized writes, and protected audit logging.

data.name: Developer / Maintainer
data.description: Maintains source code, documentation, dependencies, security policy, and model artifacts.

threats.title: Unauthorized source or model modification
threats.description: An unauthorized commit or compromised developer account could alter detection and security logic.
threats.mitigation: Use MFA, protected branches, peer review, signed commits, and required security checks.

threats.title: Changes cannot be attributed
threats.description: Changes may not be reliably attributable without protected repository audit history.
threats.mitigation: Enable repository audit logs, signed commits, pull-request approvals, and immutable release records.

data.name: Modbus Traffic Generator
data.description: infrastructure/traffic_generator.py. Generates Modbus TCP read/write polling and state-altering traffic. Rate limits, write allowlists, and emergency stop controls require validation.

threats.title: Unauthorized or modified Modbus commands
threats.description: Modbus/TCP does not inherently provide authentication or command integrity.
threats.mitigation: Restrict TCP/502, allowlist function codes and registers, and monitor command anomalies.

threats.title: Traffic generation overwhelms the testbed
threats.description: Excessive requests may exhaust the PLC emulator or monitoring stack.
threats.mitigation: Implement bounded rates, connection limits, timeouts, quotas, and emergency stop controls.

data.name: OpenPLC Emulator
data.description: Virtualized PLC endpoint in the OT testbed. Authentication, register authorization, state reset, and management isolation require validation.

threats.title: Unauthorized PLC state modification
threats.description: Unauthorized writes could alter simulated control state.
threats.mitigation: Allowlist registers and function codes, capture state snapshots, and automate rollback.

data.name: Conpot Emulator
data.description: OT honeypot/emulator component identified in the repository architecture. Exposure, service emulation, and management access require validation.

threats.title: Honeypot or emulator exposed beyond the lab
threats.description: Unexpected reachability could allow compromise of the emulator host or adjacent systems.
threats.mitigation: Place in an isolated segment, deny inbound access by default, restrict management, and test routing.

data.name:
pfSense
Firewall
data.description: Layer 3/4 firewall and ACL enforcement point. Deny-by-default rules, rule integrity, administration, and change control require validation.

threats.title: Firewall ACLs modified to permit attack traffic
threats.description: Unauthorized rule changes could bypass segmentation and Modbus restrictions.
threats.mitigation: Use MFA, administrative RBAC, approved changes, configuration backups, versioning, and audit forwarding.

data.name:
Suricata
DPI Sensor
data.description: Deep packet inspection and alert generation. Sensor health, packet loss, ruleset integrity, and time synchronization require validation.

threats.title: Sensor overload or telemetry loss
threats.description: Packet drops or sensor failure could hide malicious OT traffic.
threats.mitigation: Monitor drops, event rates, disk, process health, queues, heartbeats, and clock synchronization.

data.name: Suricata EVE Logs
data.description: infrastructure/extracted_handoff/var/log/suricata/eve.json. Integrity, retention, access control, classification, and immutable storage require validation.

threats.title: EVE telemetry altered or deleted
threats.description: Local log manipulation could change the analysis result.
threats.mitigation: Use protected centralized collection, restricted writers, cryptographic hashes or signatures, and immutable retention.

data.name: iptables Drops Log
data.description: infrastructure/logs/iptables_drops.log. Firewall-drop evidence requires integrity, timestamp synchronization, retention, and access validation.

threats.title: Firewall-drop evidence altered
threats.description: Modified drop logs could conceal blocked or attempted connections.
threats.mitigation: Forward logs to protected storage, use synchronized timestamps, restrict writers, and preserve hashes.

data.name: Modbus Telemetry CSV / PCAP
data.description: Raw OT traffic captures and datasets. Confidentiality, integrity, provenance, access control, and retention require validation.

threats.title: Raw OT telemetry disclosure
threats.description: Raw captures may reveal operational addresses, commands, register values, or timing.
threats.mitigation: Classify data, restrict access, encrypt storage, redact unnecessary fields, and define retention.

data.name: Telemetry Handoff TAR.GZ
data.description: infrastructure/ot_telemetry_handoff_2026-09-26.tar.gz. Authenticated transfer, cryptographic integrity, provenance, safe extraction, and size limits require validation.

threats.title: Telemetry archive substitution
threats.description: A manipulated archive could produce false findings.
threats.mitigation: Use authenticated transfer, SHA-256 hashes or signatures, provenance metadata, and pre-parse verification.

threats.title: Archive decompression resource exhaustion
threats.description: Oversized or malicious archives may exhaust parser resources.
threats.mitigation: Enforce size, file-count, path, symlink, extraction-depth, and decompression limits in a sandbox.

data.name: Telemetry Parser
data.description: src/log_parser.py. Ingests EVE JSON, iptables logs, Modbus CSV, and TAR.GZ archives. Sandboxing, schema validation, non-privileged execution, and provenance require validation.

threats.title: Parser executes attacker-controlled archive content
threats.description: Malicious archive content may exploit extraction or parsing behavior.
threats.mitigation: Run in a sandbox/container with read-only inputs, dropped privileges, restricted networking, and safe deserialization.

data.name: Normalized Telemetry
data.description: data/normalized_telemetry.json. Standardized ISO 8601 records consumed by triage and ML. Schema, lineage, integrity, access, and encryption require validation.

threats.title: Normalized records manipulated
threats.description: Manipulation could alter triage and ML conclusions.
threats.mitigation: Separate parser write identity from consumer read identities, add record hashes, and preserve source-event lineage.

data.name: Incident Triage
data.description: src/timeline_generator.py. Produces incident_report.json and incident_timeline.md. Code integrity, evidence references, attribution, and report signing require validation.

threats.title: Triage logic or severity classification altered
threats.description: Code integrity, dependency integrity, and release controls are not confirmed.
threats.mitigation: Use protected branches, peer review, pinned dependencies, scanning, and version metadata in reports.

data.name: ML Detection
data.description: src/ml_detector.py. Trains and evaluates Random Forest, Decision Tree, and SVM classifiers. Dataset/model provenance, train-test separation, input limits, and drift monitoring require validation.

threats.title: Training or evaluation data poisoned
threats.description: Dataset provenance, model integrity, and benchmark separation are not confirmed.
threats.mitigation: Version and sign datasets/models, track lineage, separate training from evaluation, and add poisoning checks.

threats.title: Malformed telemetry exhausts ML resources
threats.description: Input size, batch, timeout, and resource controls require validation.
threats.mitigation: Validate inputs, bound batches, apply timeouts and quotas, and report degraded execution explicitly.

data.name: Raw Dataset and Feature Vectors
data.description: data/modbus_telemetry_dataset.csv and derived feature vectors. Training/evaluation separation, poisoning resistance, access control, and provenance require validation.

threats.title: Dataset poisoning or train-test contamination
threats.description: Manipulated or improperly separated data may create misleading benchmark results.
threats.mitigation: Hash/version datasets, separate training and evaluation data, preserve lineage, and review exclusions.

data.name: Incident Reports, Timeline and ML Results
data.description: data/incident_report.json, data/incident_timeline.md, and data/ml_evaluation_results.json. Integrity, access control, redaction, retention, and reproducibility require validation.

threats.title: Reports cannot be proven from original evidence
threats.description: Evidence references, hashes, author attribution, and generation metadata are not confirmed.
threats.mitigation: Include source IDs, input hashes, code versions, timestamps, authors, and signed manifests.

threats.title: Incident details exposed
threats.description: Reports may disclose operational details or sensitive telemetry.
threats.mitigation: Restrict storage, redact sensitive values, encrypt artifacts, and enforce retention.

data.name: GitHub Repository
data.description: Source repository containing code, documentation, datasets, security policy, and dependency manifests. Repository access and branch protection require validation.

threats.title: Secrets or sensitive data committed
threats.description: Repository content, datasets, or logs could expose secrets or sensitive operational information.
threats.mitigation: Use secret scanning, sanitization checks, repository access reviews, and pre-commit validation.

data.name: Dependency Manifests
data.description: requirements.txt and infrastructure/requirements.txt. Dependency pinning, scanning, provenance, and reproducible installation require validation.

threats.title: Vulnerable or malicious dependency
threats.description: A compromised or vulnerable package could compromise parsing, telemetry, or ML execution.
threats.mitigation: Pin versions, use trusted indexes, scan dependencies, generate an SBOM, and verify package provenance.

text.text:
POLICY VALIDATION GAPS
CRITICAL: Prove Purdue-zone isolation and no production connectivity.
CRITICAL: Restrict Modbus/TCP port 502 and write function codes.
CRITICAL: Hash/sign telemetry archives and preserve immutable evidence.
CRITICAL: Sandbox archive extraction and parser execution.
HIGH: Validate pfSense ACLs, Suricata rules, and administrative MFA.
HIGH: Validate source, dependency, dataset, and model provenance.
MEDIUM: Define classification, redaction, retention, backup, and recovery.

data.name: Operator Test Commands
data.description: Operator invokes infrastructure/traffic_generator.py. Validate authentication, authorization, approvals, and auditability.

threats.title: Uncontrolled operator access
threats.description: An attacker could impersonate an operator or execute unauthorized tests.
threats.mitigation: Use named accounts, MFA, RBAC, approvals, and append-only audit logs.

data.name: Modbus/TCP Commands
data.description: Traffic generator sends Modbus TCP read/write traffic to OpenPLC and/or Conpot. Validate source allowlisting, write controls, rate limits, and network isolation.

threats.title: Modbus command injection or tampering
threats.description: Modbus/TCP lacks native authentication and integrity protection.
threats.mitigation: Restrict TCP/502, allowlist sources and function codes, and use protocol-aware monitoring.

data.name: OT Traffic to Conpot
data.description: Traffic generator may interact with the Conpot emulator. Validate service exposure and isolation.

threats.title: Unexpected emulator exposure
threats.description: Unexpected reachability could enable compromise of the emulator or host.
threats.mitigation: Use isolated networks, deny-by-default ACLs, restricted management, and routing tests.

data.name: OT Traffic Inspection
data.description: OpenPLC and Conpot traffic traverses pfSense and is inspected by Suricata.

threats.title: Monitoring blind spot
threats.description: Incorrect sensor placement or packet loss could prevent detection.
threats.mitigation: Validate sensor placement, mirror traffic, monitor drops, and alert on missing telemetry.

data.name: EVE JSON Events
data.description: Suricata writes EVE JSON telemetry. Validate protected storage, integrity, retention, and access.

threats.title: EVE event alteration
threats.description: Events could be modified or deleted before analysis.
threats.mitigation: Use centralized protected collection, restricted writers, hashes/signatures, and immutable retention.

data.name: Telemetry Handoff Archive
data.description: EVE JSON, iptables logs, and Modbus captures are packaged for analysis. Validate authenticated transfer, hashes, provenance, and safe handling.

threats.title: Archive substitution
threats.description: A manipulated archive could produce false findings.
threats.mitigation: Use authenticated transfer, cryptographic hashes/signatures, provenance metadata, and pre-parse verification.

data.name: Archive Extraction and Parsing
data.description: src/log_parser.py extracts and ingests archive contents. Validate sandboxing, path traversal protection, symlink handling, and resource limits.

threats.title: Archive extraction privilege escalation
threats.description: Malicious archive content could exploit extraction or parser behavior.
threats.mitigation: Use non-privileged sandboxed extraction, reject symlinks, enforce path boundaries and resource limits.

data.name: Normalized ISO 8601 Records
data.description: src/log_parser.py writes data/normalized_telemetry.json. Validate schema, lineage, hashes, write ownership, and access.

threats.title: Evidence transformation tampering
threats.description: Incorrect or manipulated normalization could alter downstream analysis.
threats.mitigation: Validate schemas, record parser version and hashes, and link normalized records to source events.

data.name: Telemetry to Incident Triage
data.description: src/timeline_generator.py reads normalized telemetry and generates incident metrics and Markdown timeline.

data.name: Telemetry to ML Detection
data.description: src/ml_detector.py reads normalized telemetry and trains/evaluates classifiers. Validate dataset integrity, separation, input limits, and resource quotas.

threats.title: ML input poisoning or resource exhaustion
threats.description: Manipulated or oversized telemetry may distort results or exhaust inference resources.
threats.mitigation: Validate inputs, enforce batch/resource limits, and preserve dataset lineage.

data.name: Incident Reports
data.description: src/timeline_generator.py writes data/incident_report.json and data/incident_timeline.md.

threats.title: Incident report manipulation
threats.description: Reports could be modified to change incident conclusions.
threats.mitigation: Hash or sign reports, include code/input versions, and preserve immutable prior versions.

data.name: ML Benchmark Results
data.description: src/ml_detector.py writes data/ml_evaluation_results.json. Validate model, dataset, metrics, thresholds, failures, and excluded samples.

threats.title: Benchmark results altered or selectively reported
threats.description: Benchmark integrity and reproducibility are not confirmed.
threats.mitigation: Create signed manifests containing model, dataset, metrics, thresholds, failures, and excluded samples.

data.name: Source Code and Dependencies
data.description: Developer accesses the GitHub repository and dependency manifests. Validate MFA, branch protection, code review, dependency scanning, and secret scanning.

threats.title: Software supply-chain compromise
threats.description: Malicious code or dependency changes could compromise the full pipeline.
threats.mitigation: Use protected branches, signed commits, dependency pinning/scanning, SBOMs, and reproducible builds.

data.name: Dependency Installation
data.description: Python dependencies are installed from repository manifests. Validate trusted package sources, hashes, scanning, and isolation.

threats.title: Malicious dependency installation
threats.description: A malicious or vulnerable package could execute with pipeline privileges.
threats.mitigation: Pin versions, verify hashes, use trusted indexes, scan packages, and install in isolated environments.

data.name: OT Network Boundary
data.description: Boundary separating the isolated OT testbed from enterprise/developer access.

data.name: Analysis Evidence Boundary
data.description: Boundary protecting telemetry, parser execution, analysis processes, ML assets, and reports.

diagrams.description: Complete repository-level STRIDE model. Undocumented controls are represented as open validation gaps rather than confirmed implementations.
